name: TCRBreastSEQLSCodeSystem
title: 台灣癌症登記 局部與全身治療順序（SEQLS）
description: Taiwan Cancer Registry code table for SEQLS (局部與全身治療順序). 碼冊出處：Longform p.233-235 區域治療與全身性治療順序 (#4.2.1.6). Generated from tcr_decoder; every code round-trips through decode/encode (tests/test_codebook_conformance.py).

concept.display: 首次療程中有區域治療與全身性治療，但順序未明；或結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案。
concept.definition: 首次療程中有區域治療與全身性治療，但順序未明；或結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案。 / Sequence unknown, or systemic therapy is the main treatment modality (nodal lymphoma, haematologic malignancy, or distant metastasis)

designation.value: Sequence unknown, or systemic therapy is the main treatment modality (nodal lymphoma, haematologic malignancy, or distant metastasis)

concept.display: 首次療程僅有局部性藥物治療而未使用全身性藥物治療(不論是否有區域治療)。
concept.definition: 首次療程僅有局部性藥物治療而未使用全身性藥物治療(不論是否有區域治療)。 / The first course had only regional drug therapy (TACE, intraperitoneal, intrapleural, intrathecal, intravesical, intraocular or intratumoral), with no systemic drug therapy

designation.value: The first course had only regional drug therapy (TACE, intraperitoneal, intrapleural, intrathecal, intravesical, intraocular or intratumoral), with no systemic drug therapy

concept.display: 首次療程有全身性藥物治療而無區域治療(不論是否有局部性藥物治療)。
concept.definition: 首次療程有全身性藥物治療而無區域治療(不論是否有局部性藥物治療)。 / No locoregional therapy: the first course had systemic drug therapy only (regional drug therapy such as TACE may still have been given)

designation.value: No locoregional therapy: the first course had systemic drug therapy only (regional drug therapy such as TACE may still have been given)

concept.display: 不清楚是否有區域療法與全身性治療。
concept.definition: 不清楚是否有區域療法與全身性治療。 / Unknown whether the case had locoregional and/or systemic therapy

designation.value: Unknown whether the case had locoregional and/or systemic therapy

concept.display: 首次療程中不含化學藥物、荷爾蒙、免疫及標靶治療，不論是否有接受區域治療。
concept.definition: 首次療程中不含化學藥物、荷爾蒙、免疫及標靶治療，不論是否有接受區域治療。 / No systemic drug therapy in the first course (chemotherapy, hormone/steroid, immunotherapy or targeted therapy), whether or not locoregional therapy was given

designation.value: No systemic drug therapy in the first course (chemotherapy, hormone/steroid, immunotherapy or targeted therapy), whether or not locoregional therapy was given

concept.display: 導引/前導性輔助療法(手術前進行全身性治療)
concept.definition: 導引/前導性輔助療法(手術前進行全身性治療) / Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy)

designation.value: Induction / neoadjuvant systemic therapy (before locoregional therapy, or before radiation when radiation is the main locoregional therapy)

concept.display: 同步/併行療法(同步全身性藥物放射治療 CSRT，或手術旁全身性藥物治療)
